profile.headline: Retired
profile.summary:
Versatile Information Technology professional experienced in software development and configuration for medical, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, government and commercial industries. Expertise in systems analysis and design, application programming, testing, database, project management and infrastructure.
•  Tenacious problem solver. Able to bring proactive solutions to difficult and high-pressure situations.
•  Highly responsive to changing demands
•  Effective communicator. Adept at documenting and presenting technical information.
•  Team player, working to deliver excellent customer service and on-time/on-budget projects.

Specialties: Software Development
LabWare LIMS

positions.title: LIMS Administrator / Software Developer
positions.description: Software coding and configuration of a new LabWare Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) to replace several 20+ year old legacy systems. Work on team of 20+ programmers to implement 3000+ business requirements. Collaborate with business leads to clarify use case requirements and gain coding / configuration acceptance. Develop and execute unit test scripts as well as provide expertise to formal test teams (integration, performance, user acceptance). Peer review code developed by configuration team. Collaborate with interface teams to validate the LIMS interface with manufacturing and finance systems. Resolve coding defects on time for scheduled builds. Interact with vendor LabWare to resolve base product issues and obtain enhanced software functions. Required technical skills include LabWare, LIMS BASIC, Crystal Reports, Oracle SQL, ClearQuest, Requisite Pro, and Visual SourceSafe. This corporate transformational project consists of 130+ team members located throughout the US and in Geneva, Switzerland.

positions.title: Network Operations Manager
positions.description: Manage data and voice systems for HHC and Marion County Health Department enterprise comprised of 800+ desktops and thin clients, 50+ servers, storage area network, local and wide area network, including headquarters and 14 remote sites, and voice mail system. Responsible for 11 direct reports consisting of Tiers 1, 2 and 3 support team. Manage 3rd party consulting firms for projects and supplemental support. Determine infrastructure improvement priorities, make recommendations and manage implementations. Collaborate with sister organization Wishard Hospital on joint IT projects and future planning. Notable projects: Collaborate with applications group to implement and support .NET web applications with SQL backend, support Oracle LIMS, antispam appliance implementation, Domino infrastructure upgrade, Citrix farm upgrade, PC refresh, voice mail system replacement, SAN upgrade.

company.name: Health & Hospital Corporation of Marion County
